pages.title: Gear and Curios
pages.text: **Curios** adds extra equipment slots beside armor: rings, necklaces, belts, hands and more. Several mods fill them, so you can wear gear on top of your armor.
In this pack: **Artifacts** (hats, boots, gloves, belts and pendants), **Iron's Spells** (rings, necklaces, spell books) and Critters and Companions (pearl necklaces).

pages.title: Cloud in a Bottle
pages.text: A double jump. One of the Artifacts items, found in loot rather than crafted.

pages.title: Snorkel
pages.text: Underwater breathing helper, with Flippers and Aqua-Dashers. See Diving Gear.

pages.title: Mimic
pages.text: Some chests are Mimics. Artifacts also spawn in underground camps and in loot.

Artifacts are mostly found, not made. Look in underground campsites, in chests and in Mimics. [#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#]() gives each player their own loot. Water gear is covered in [#](2E5AAC)[Diving Gear](entry://ocean/diving)[#]().
